title: 第一卷 第110章 性子要强的白天晴！

第(1/3)页

但很快，白天晴便自嘲地笑着摇了摇头。

她知道王建军对谁都是客气有礼的，这份贴心的关照并不是因为她特殊。

而她对王建军，也不过是对哥哥的那种崇拜和仰慕，和男女之情无关。

她并不想玷污这份感情。

“怎么了？”

王建军刚坐下来，拿好筷子，便看见白天晴又笑又摇头的，有些奇怪。

“没什么，就是突然有些好奇王大哥的妻子是什么样的人？”

“能配上王大哥的女人，一定是天底下最好的女人。”

白天晴由衷地说着，话里话外全是真诚，不带一丝嫉妒。

她也是真这么想的。

毕竟也只有天底下最好的女人，才能和王建军相配了。

一听到这话，王建军却苦笑了起来，但提到自家妻子时，眼神中的温柔和深情是做不得假的。

作为女人的白天晴，一眼便看得出来。

“她呀，简直是天底下最傻的女人了，跟着我，她吃了不少苦。”

“现在日子好过一些了，我只想让她们娘俩的生活变得好一点，她跟着我确实太委屈了。”

这话让白天晴有些惊讶。

毕竟她们这些员工，私下还说过，王建军这么年轻，又这么有商业头脑。

如今身价怕是也有好几万了，怎么着也算是事业有成，做他的妻子一定很享福。

有不少人在私底下都很羡慕李南枝呢。

可没想到从王建军自己嘴里说出来的，却是这样的话。

看来家家都有本难念的经啊。

白天晴知趣的没有多问，只是说道。

“若是嫂子一个人在家看着孩子无聊的话，也可以来咱们馆里。”

“我平时也没什么事，要是嫂子不嫌我笨，我也愿意跟嫂子一起出门逛逛。”

白天晴真心实意的说道。

她不知道该怎么报答王建军，便想着爱屋及乌，若是能帮李南枝点忙，这样她自己心里也还能好过一些。

王建军听到这话，倒是觉得可行。

But soon, Bai Tianqing laughed at herself and shook her head.

She knew that Wang Jianjun was polite and courteous to everyone, and this caring consideration was not because she was special.

And her worship and admiration for Wang Jianjun was nothing more than her brother's admiration, and it had nothing to do with the relationship between men and women.

She didn't want to tarnish the relationship.

"What's wrong?"

As soon as Wang Jianjun sat down and picked up his chopsticks, he saw Bai Tianqing smiling and shaking her head, which was a little strange.

"Nothing, I just suddenly became curious about what kind of person Brother Wang's wife is?"

"A woman who can match Brother Wang must be the best woman in the world."

Tian Tianqing spoke sincerely, with sincerity inside and outside her words, without a hint of jealousy.

She really thought so too.

After all, only the best woman in the world can match Wang Jianjun.

Upon hearing this, Wang Jianjun smiled bitterly, but when he mentioned his wife, the tenderness and affection in his eyes could not be faked.

As a woman, Bai Tianqing can be seen at a glance.

"She is simply the stupidest woman in the world. She has suffered a lot by following me."

"Now that life is getting better, I just want to make their lives a little better. It's really unfair for her to follow me."

These words surprised Bai Tianqing.

After all, they employees have said privately that Wang Jianjun is so young and has such business acumen.

Now he is probably worth tens of thousands, and he has a successful career anyway. Being his wife must be a blessing.

Many people secretly envy Li Nanzhi.

But I didn't expect that these words would come out of Wang Jianjun's own mouth.

It seems that every family has sutras that are difficult to recite.

Bai Tianqing knew what was going on and didn't ask any more questions, she just said.

"If my sister-in-law is bored at home watching the children, she can come to our library."

"I usually have nothing to do. If my sister-in-law doesn't think I'm stupid, I'm willing to go out with her."

Bai Tianqing said sincerely.

She didn't know how to repay Wang Jianjun, so she thought that if Aiwujiwu could help Li Nanzhi, she would feel better.

When Wang Jianjun heard this, he thought it was feasible.
